title: Target’s Holiday Marketing Campaign
summary: Target is making it easier for guests to "Gift It Your All" this holiday season with their holiday marketing campaign, The Academy of Giftology.
body_markdown:
## The Academy of Giftology


With 60% of consumers saying thoughtful gift-giving makes them feel emotionally fulfilled and that finding the perfect gift matters more than finding the cheapest one, Target is leaning into what makes gifting meaningful — helping guests find affordable gifts they can't wait to give. That idea comes to life through Target's[Academy of Giftology](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NO0d9tM2UF8) , a new holiday marketing campaign designed to help guests master the art of great gifting and feel confident as they discover just the right gifts at a great value. The campaign takes a playful approach to relatable gifting challenges, helping guests find gifts they'll be excited to give and loved ones will be excited to receive — from the kid who loves puppies to the person who says they want nothing at all.


Gifting is the thread connecting the entire Target holiday experience — from social inspiration and our curated assortment to incredible value and easy ways to shop. Whether guests are browsing our aisles with a Starbucks in hand, shopping online or in our app, or picking up a Drive Up order, every touchpoint helps them discover the right gift and feel confident about giving it — making the season easier, more inspiring and more joyful.
